import hashlib, importlib.util, json, os, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from src.tools.pbs_mixed_accounting import finalized_split

NAME = 'diag_mixed_relative_payload_repair_01'
assert os.environ.get('CVPR_RUN_NAME') == NAME
root = Path.cwd().resolve()
targets = [('gpu_pack_test_priority_full_single_01_retry2', '709674.hopper-m-02'),
           ('gpu_pack_test_priority_full_single_02_retry1', '709656.hopper-m-02')]
destination = root/'logs/review'/NAME
destination.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
def sha(p): return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def write_new(p, value):
    p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with p.open('x') as f: json.dump(value,f,indent=2,sort_keys=True)
copies, commands, originals = [], [], []
for parent, job in targets:
    name = parent+'_mixed_accounting'
    result_path=root/'results'/(name+'.json')
    old=json.loads(result_path.read_text()); originals.append((parent,job,old))
    command=old['_meta']['command']
    assert command[:3] == ['python3','-m','src.tools.pbs_mixed_accounting']
    assert old['_meta']['name'] == old['config']['name'] == name
    absolute=old['config']['payload_reference']['file']
    payload=(root/absolute).resolve(); relative=str(payload.relative_to(root))
    assert absolute != relative and command[command.index('--payload')+1] == absolute
    assert payload.stat().st_mode & 0o222 == 0 and sha(payload) == old['config']['payload_reference']['sha256']
    revised=list(command); revised[revised.index('--payload')+1]=relative
    assert sum(a!=b for a,b in zip(command,revised)) == 1
    commands.append(revised)
    for p in [result_path,root/'logs/runs'/(name+'.log'),root/'logs/runs'/(name+'.meta.json')]:
        data=p.read_bytes(); digest=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
        archive=destination/'original'/p.relative_to(root)
        archive.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        with archive.open('xb') as f:f.write(data)
        assert archive.read_bytes() == data and sha(p) == digest
        copies.append({'original_path':str(p.relative_to(root)),'archive_reference':{'file':str(archive.relative_to(root)),
            'sha256':digest,'bytes':len(data)}})
write_new(destination/'archive_manifest.json',{'reason':'Original fixed-name mixed consumer requires payload reference string to equal the submitter repo-relative ledger path. Original scientific/canonical data are unchanged. Original run_logged archives the old result itself; original log/meta copied before rerun.',
 'original_files':copies,'replacement_commands':commands})
print('MIXED_ORIGINAL_BYTES_ARCHIVED: '+json.dumps(copies,sort_keys=True),flush=True)
for command in commands:
    name=command[command.index('--name')+1]
    subprocess.run(['python3','scripts/run_logged.py','--name',name,'--seed','0','--',*command],check=True)
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('original_phase_for_repair',root/'scripts/pbs/submit_phase.py')
phase=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(phase)
verified=[]
for parent,job,old in originals:
    p=root/'results'/(parent+'_mixed_accounting.json');new=json.loads(p.read_text())
    account=(root/new['config']['account_reference']['file']).resolve()
    canonical=phase._final_accounting(root,{job},paths=[account])
    assert set(canonical)=={job}
    row={'name':parent,'job_id':job,'payload':new['config']['payload_reference']['file']}
    split=finalized_split(root,row,canonical[job])
    assert split['charged_gpu_hours_by_group']==old['metrics']['charged_gpu_hours_by_group']
    assert split['total_charged_gpu_hours']==old['metrics']['total_charged_gpu_hours']
    old_hash=hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(old,sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()
    archived=[a for a in (root/'results/_archive').glob(parent+'_mixed_accounting.*.json')
              if hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(json.loads(a.read_text()),sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()==old_hash]
    assert archived
    verified.append({'job_id':job,'original_run_logged_result_archive':str(archived[-1].relative_to(root)),
        'replacement_result':{'file':str(p.relative_to(root)),'sha256':sha(p)},'original_finalized_split_passed':True,
        'canonical_reference':new['config']['account_reference'],'charged_gpu_hours_by_group':split['charged_gpu_hours_by_group']})
write_new(destination/'verified.json',{'repairs':verified})
print('MIXED_RELATIVE_PAYLOAD_REPAIRED: '+json.dumps(verified,sort_keys=True),flush=True)
